gloss: to resemble; to be similar to

definitions.gloss: to resemble; to be similar to; to be analogous to
definitions.explanation: To share common characteristics or features with something else, making the two seem alike.

{類似|るいじ}した⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{出回|でまわ}っている→出回る：11736_demawaru⟧。
examples.english: Many similar products are on the market.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{類似|るいじ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: These symptoms resemble influenza, but the cause is different.

notes:
{類似|るいじ}する is a formal, analytical word for similarity. It is commonly used in legal, academic, and business contexts — for example, when comparing products, cases, or phenomena. The participial form {類似|るいじ}した (similar) is very frequent.

USAGE:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{類似|るいじ}する: to be similar to ~
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{類似|るいじ}する: to be similar to ~ (interchangeable with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧)
- {類似|るいじ}した + noun: similar + noun

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{類似|るいじ}→類似：14672_ruiji⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: imitation product; knockoff
- ⟦{類似|るいじ}{点|てん}→類似点：24577_ruijiten⟧: point of similarity
- ⟦{類似|るいじ}{性|せい}→類似性：21772_ruijisei⟧: similarity; resemblance
- ⟦{類似|るいじ}→類似：14672_ruiji⟧⟦{商標|しょうひょう}→商標：12019_shouhyou⟧: similar trademark
- ⟦{類似|るいじ}→類似：14672_ruiji⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: similar expression

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{似|に}ている→似る：01159_niru⟧: to be similar; to look alike — everyday, conversational word for resemblance
- ⟦{共通|きょうつう}→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have in common — focuses on shared elements rather than overall resemblance
- ⟦{酷似|こくじ}→酷似：19943_kokuji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to closely resemble — stronger, implies near-identical similarity
